instruction: Navigate to the Steam store and add the Half-Life 2 Soundtrack DLC to your shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: This variation maintains the same complexity as the original task: navigate to a game's official site and Steam store, search for specific DLC content (soundtrack), and add it to cart. Changed from Dota 2 soundtrack to Half-Life 2 soundtrack while preserving the exact same interaction pattern. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric and get_page_info getter. The task verifies that the Half-Life 2 Soundtrack appears in the Steam cart page content.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if Half-Life 2: Soundtrack is found in cart content, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_page_info) correctly navigates to Steam cart page and extracts full page content including HTML
Metric (is_added_to_steam_cart) correctly handles expected parameter - when expected.type='rule', it receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['items']
Metric logic correctly checks if item string appears in cart page content using substring matching
Evaluator semantically verifies the instruction requirement: checking if 'Half-Life 2: Soundtrack' is present in cart
Data flow is correct: page content -> substring search -> binary result

Minor string matching risk: uses exact substring match which may fail if Steam displays item with slight variation (e.g., without colon, different capitalization), but this is reasonable for practical use
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding fuzzy string matching or multiple string variants to handle potential display name variations on Steam (e.g., 'Half-Life 2 Soundtrack', 'Half-Life 2: Soundtrack', 'HL2 Soundtrack')
Current implementation is acceptable as-is for most cases - exact string match should work if expected value matches Steam's actual display text
